posts.title: You're a team lead. Now what?
posts.description: You don't scale. Your team does. Three things they need from you: the who, the what, and the why. Get these right and the team delivers. Get any wrong and no process will save you.

posts.title: What kind of team do you have?
posts.description: There are two kinds of engineering teams: task teams optimized for efficiency, and autonomous teams optimized for flexibility. Most companies think they're running the second. Most are running the first. Here's how to tell — and why the misalignment costs you your best people.

posts.title: The efficiency vs. flexibility framework for engineering organizations
posts.description: Most engineering orgs are a maze with invisible walls. A practical framework for deciding where to be flexible and where to be efficient — and making it explicit.
